description: Build the unsigned transaction that creates a new policy. Returns {to, value, data} for YOUR wallet to sign and submit — the submitting address becomes the policy owner. `value` is the protocol creation fee in wei.

metadataHash.description: optional keccak256 of the metadata document — on-chain tamper-evidence for the URI's content

metadataURI.description: optional metadata pointer, informational only; prefer ipfs:// (content-immutable)

openMembership.description: true: every address counts as a member

transferable.description: true: ownership can be transferred later

name: policy_create
